false_negative_audits.original_supporting_evidence: UAB appeared only through mechanical IPEDS signals, although current official pages establish a direct-entry Computer Science PhD, seed-relevant programming-languages and verification work, and majority-but-not-universal doctoral assistantship support.

Bamberg's exact English International Software Systems Science MSc was absent from the bounded funnel despite official evidence of a research-oriented software-systems curriculum, detailed international eligibility rules, research projects, and no tuition.
